# DEB-TKTD - Imidacloprid

```{r}
Condition_order <- c("Ctrl", "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "C5", "C6", "C7", "C8", "C9", "C10")

df_data_EC50 <- f_import_data_DEBTKTD() |> 
  mutate(
    #Condition = fct_reorder(Condition, Dose)
    Condition = fct_relevel(Condition, Condition_order)
  ) |> 
  filter(!(Experiment_type == "Repro" & Time == 14))


```

## Effect of IMD

### Model fit

```{r}
Molec <- "IMD"
path_fig <- here::here("fig/DEBTKTD_Models")

# 1 pMoA
path_A_IMD_A <- here::here("mod/Z_DEB-TKTD/IMD/A_IMD_A")
path_B_IMD_M <- here::here("mod/Z_DEB-TKTD/IMD/B_IMD_M")
path_C_IMD_G <- here::here("mod/Z_DEB-TKTD/IMD/C_IMD_G")
path_D_IMD_R <- here::here("mod/Z_DEB-TKTD/IMD/D_IMD_R")

# 2 pMoA
path_E_IMD_AM <- here::here("mod/Z_DEB-TKTD/IMD/E_IMD_AM")
path_F_IMD_AG <- here::here("mod/Z_DEB-TKTD/IMD/F_IMD_AG")
path_G_IMD_AR <- here::here("mod/Z_DEB-TKTD/IMD/G_IMD_AR")
path_H_IMD_MG <- here::here("mod/Z_DEB-TKTD/IMD/H_IMD_MG")
path_I_IMD_MR <- here::here("mod/Z_DEB-TKTD/IMD/I_IMD_MR")
path_J_IMD_GR <- here::here("mod/Z_DEB-TKTD/IMD/J_IMD_GR")

# # 3 pMoA
# path_K_IMD_AMG <- here::here("mod/Z_DEB-TKTD/IMD/K_IMD_AMG")
# path_L_IMD_AMR <- here::here("mod/Z_DEB-TKTD/IMD/L_IMD_AMR")
# path_M_IMD_AGR <- here::here("mod/Z_DEB-TKTD/IMD/M_IMD_AGR")
# path_N_IMD_MGR <- here::here("mod/Z_DEB-TKTD/IMD/N_IMD_MGR")


df_data_fit_IMD <- f_import_data_DEBTKTD() |> 
  filter(Molecule == Molec) |> 
  mutate(No_sim = case_when(
    Experiment_type == "Repro" ~ No_sim+9,
    .default = No_sim
  ))

```

```{r fit_IMD, message=F, warning=F}

path_fig <- here::here("fig/DEBTKTD_Models")
Molec <- "IMD"
df_data_fit_IMD <- f_import_data_DEBTKTD() |> filter(Molecule == Molec)
OM_diff <- TRUE

NbIter <- 30000
RTOL <- 1e-10
ATOL <- 1e-9

text_priors <- '
Distrib (nec,          TruncNormal_cv,            1000,     0.2, 10, 100000);
Distrib (b,            LogUniform,                0.0001,          10);

# Calcul des vraissemblances
Distrib (Sigma_W, TruncNormal,  0.005, 1, 0.01, 100);'

text_likelihood <- 'Likelihood (Weight,   Normal, Prediction(Weight), Sigma_W);  
Likelihood (Reproduction, Poisson, Prediction(Reproduction));'

######## A_IMD_A ##############################################################
seeds <- c(C1 = 3303, C2 = 6666, C3 = 2212)
f_In_TKTD_tot(path_A_IMD_A, Molec, text_priors, text_likelihood, NbIter, seeds, RTOL, ATOL)

######## B_IMD_M ##############################################################
seeds <- c(C1 = 3345, C2 = 6666, C3 = 2112)
f_In_TKTD_tot(path_B_IMD_M, Molec, text_priors, text_likelihood, NbIter, seeds, RTOL, ATOL)

######## C_IMD_G ##############################################################
seeds <- c(C1 = 3303, C2 = 6666, C3 = 2212)
f_In_TKTD_tot(path_C_IMD_G, Molec, text_priors, text_likelihood, NbIter, seeds, RTOL, ATOL)

######## D_IMD_R ##############################################################
seeds <- c(C1 = 3345, C2 = 3666, C3 = 2212)
f_In_TKTD_tot(path_D_IMD_R, Molec, text_priors, text_likelihood, NbIter, seeds, RTOL, ATOL)

######## E_IMD_AM ##############################################################
seeds <- c(C1 = 3345, C2 = 3666, C3 = 2212)
f_In_TKTD_tot(path_E_IMD_AM, Molec, text_priors, text_likelihood, NbIter, seeds, RTOL, ATOL)

######## F_IMD_AG ##############################################################
seeds <- c(C1 = 3345, C2 = 3666, C3 = 2212)
f_In_TKTD_tot(path_F_IMD_AG, Molec, text_priors, text_likelihood, NbIter, seeds, RTOL, ATOL)

######## G_IMD_AR ##############################################################
seeds <- c(C1 = 3345, C2 = 3666, C3 = 2212)
f_In_TKTD_tot(path_G_IMD_AR, Molec, text_priors, text_likelihood, NbIter, seeds, RTOL, ATOL)

######## H_IMD_MG ##############################################################
seeds <- c(C1 = 3345, C2 = 3666, C3 = 2212)
```

### Estimates results

```{r}
n_data_Weight <- length(na.omit(df_data_fit_IMD$Weight))
n_data_Reproduction <- length(na.omit(df_data_fit_IMD$Reproduction))
n_data_fit <- n_data_Weight + n_data_Reproduction

######### A_IMD_A ###############################################################

MCMC_out_A_IMD_A <- f_MCSim(path_A_IMD_A)

NC_A_IMD_A <- MCMC_out_A_IMD_A$NC
Nb_param_A_IMD_A <- MCMC_out_A_IMD_A$Nb_param
Nb_experiment_A_IMD_A <- MCMC_out_A_IMD_A$Nb_experiment
Nb_iter_kept_A_IMD_A <- MCMC_out_A_IMD_A$Nb_iter_kept
N_iter_setpoint_A_IMD_A <- MCMC_out_A_IMD_A$N_iter_setpoint
L_parameters_A_IMD_A <- unique(MCMC_out_A_IMD_A$Priors$Nom)

LL_A_IMD_A <- f_get_mode(MCMC_out_A_IMD_A$df_LnData$LnData)
k_A_IMD_A <- Nb_param_A_IMD_A - 1 # On enlève le Sigma_W

BIC_A_IMD_A <- -2*LL_A_IMD_A+k_A_IMD_A*log(n_data_fit)

Summary_res_A_IMD_A <- 
  as.data.frame(MCMC_out_A_IMD_A$Summary_res)[1:length(L_parameters_A_IMD_A)] |> 
  mutate(Model = "A_IMD_A")

#Summary_res_A_IMD_A
```

```{r resall}
#| tbl-cap: Estimation results from all models. 

#list_models <- c("A_IMD_A", "B_IMD_M", "C_IMD_G", "D_IMD_R", "E_IMD_AM", "F_IMD_AG", "G_IMD_AR", "H_IMD_MG", "I_IMD_MR", "J_IMD_GR", "K_IMD_AMG", "L_IMD_AMR", "M_IMD_AGR", "N_IMD_MGR")

list_models <- c("A_IMD_A", "B_IMD_M", "C_IMD_G", "D_IMD_R", "E_IMD_AM", "F_IMD_AG", "G_IMD_AR", "H_IMD_MG", "I_IMD_MR", "J_IMD_GR")

list_model_summary <- mget(paste0("Summary_res_", list_models))

param_order <- c(
  "nec", "b"
)

format_summary <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    rename_with(~ str_remove(., "\\.1\\.$")) %>%
    rownames_to_column("stat") %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -c(stat, Model),
      names_to = "param",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = stat,
      values_from = value
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      value = str_c(
        round(Result_mode, 4),
        " [", round(`2.5%`, 4),
        " ; ", round(`97.5%`, 4), "]"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(Model, param, value) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = param,
      values_from = value
    )
}

df_result <- list_model_summary %>%
  map(format_summary) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Model,
    any_of(param_order),
    everything()
  ) |> 
  left_join(df_LL_BIC) |> 
  arrange(BIC)

df_result |> datatable(
  options = list(
    dom = 't',
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    columnDefs = list(
      list(className = 'dt-left', targets = "_all")
      )
    ),
  class="hover"
  )
```

```{r, message=F, warning=F, echo=F}
#| fig-cap: Evolution of likelihood and deviance ratio through the iterations.

p1 <- ggplot(
  MCMC_out_A_IMD_A$df_LnPost_start |> 
      filter(iteration !=1),

    x = iteration, 
    y = LnPosterior, 
    color = Chain
    )
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Chains", label = lab_chains, values = pal_chains) +
  labs(
    x = "First half iterations", 
    y = "LnPosterior"
    ) +
  theme_minimal()

p2 <- ggplot(
  MCMC_out_A_IMD_A$df_LnPost |> 
      filter(iteration !=1), 
  aes(
    x = iteration, 
    y = LnPosterior, 
    color = Chain
    )
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Chains", label = lab_chains, values = pal_chains) +
  labs(
    x = paste(MCMC_out_A_IMD_A$Nb_iter_kept, "last iterations"), 
    y = "LnPosterior"
    ) +
  theme_minimal()

p3 <- ggplot(
  MCMC_out_A_IMD_A$df_Devc |> 
      filter(iteration !=1), 
  aes(
    x = iteration, 
    y = RatioDeviance, 
    color = Chain
    )
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Chains", label = lab_chains, values = pal_chains) +
  labs(
    x = paste(MCMC_out_A_IMD_A$Nb_iter_kept, "last iterations"), 
    y = "Ratio Deviance"
    ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_LL <- p1 + p2 + p3 +
```

### Chains convergence

```{r, echo=F, message = F, warning = F}

####### A_IMD_A #################################################################

# Large format per chain
mcmc_list_A_IMD_A <- lapply(
  split(
    MCMC_out_A_IMD_A$Chains, 
    MCMC_out_A_IMD_A$Chains$Chain
    ),
  function(d) {
    wide <- d %>%
      dplyr::select(Iteration, Parameter, value) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = Parameter, values_from = value) %>%
      arrange(Iteration)
   mcmc(as.matrix(wide[,-1]))
})

mcmc_list_A_IMD_A <- as.mcmc.list(mcmc_list_A_IMD_A)


####### F_IMD_AG #################################################################

# Large format per chain
mcmc_list_F_IMD_AG <- lapply(
  split(
    MCMC_out_F_IMD_AG$Chains, 
    MCMC_out_F_IMD_AG$Chains$Chain
    ),
  function(d) {
    wide <- d %>%
      dplyr::select(Iteration, Parameter, value) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = Parameter, values_from = value) %>%
      arrange(Iteration)
   mcmc(as.matrix(wide[,-1]))
})

mcmc_list_F_IMD_AG <- as.mcmc.list(mcmc_list_F_IMD_AG)
```

## A_IMD_A

```{r, echo=F, message=F, warning=F}
#| fig-cap: Chains convergence.
#| label: fig-chainsconvergence_A_IMD_A
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 8

  par(mfrow=c(1,3))

  gelman.plot(mcmc_list_A_IMD_A,
            bin.width = 10,      # Number of observations per segment,
            # first segment --> at least 50 iterations.
            max.bins = 50,       # Maximum number of bins, excluding the last one
            confidence = 0.95,   # Coverage probability of confidence interval.
            transform = FALSE,   # improve the normality of the distribution
            autoburnin=TRUE)     # Remove first half of sequence

  
  gelman <- gelman.diag(
    mcmc_list_A_IMD_A, 
    confidence = 0.95, 
    transform=FALSE, 
    autoburnin=TRUE, 
    multivariate=TRUE
    )
  
  print(gelman)
```

```{r, echo=F, message=F, warning=F}
#| fig-cap: Distributions of the priors and the posteriors.
#| label: fig-post_A_IMD_A
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 8

n_samples <- 1e5 # Simulation of the distribution

df_priors_dist <- MCMC_out_A_IMD_A$Priors |> 
  dplyr::select(Nom, Distribution, P1, P2, P3, P4) |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(samples = case_when(
    Distribution == "Uniform" ~ list(runif(n_samples, min = P1, max = P2)),
    Distribution == "Normal" ~ list(rnorm(n_samples, mean = P1, sd = P2)),
    Distribution == "LogUniform" ~ list(exp(runif(n_samples, min = log(P1), max = log(P2)))),
    Distribution == "TruncNormal" ~ list(rtruncnorm(n_samples, a = P3, b = P4, mean = P1, sd = P2)),     Distribution == "TruncNormal_cv" ~ list(rtruncnorm(n_samples, a = P3, b = P4, mean = P1, sd = P2*P1))
  )) |> 
  unnest(samples)

alpha_prior <- 0.5
alpha_post <- 0.5
col_prior <- Nord_snow[1]
col_post <- col_IMD

MCMC_out_A_IMD_A$Chains_plot <- MCMC_out_A_IMD_A$Chains |> 
  mutate(Nom = str_remove(Parameter, "\\.\\d+\\.$")) 

p_post <- ggplot() +
  
  # Priors
  stat_halfeye(
    data = df_priors_dist,
    aes(
       x = samples,
       ),
    alpha = alpha_prior,
    fill = col_prior,
    color = col_prior,
    normalize = "xy"
    ) +
  
  # Posterior
  stat_halfeye(
    data = subset(MCMC_out_A_IMD_A$Chains_plot, Nom %in% L_parameters_A_IMD_A),
    mapping = aes(
      x=value
    ),
    fill = col_post,
    color = col_post,
    alpha = alpha_post,
    normalize = "xy"
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(~Nom, scales = "free")+
  scale_x_log10()+
  labs(
    title = "Posterior and prior distributions", 
    x = "Parameter value", 
    y = "Density"
    ) +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(
    title=element_text(face="bold")
  )

p_post
```

## Summary

```{r}

Condition_order <- c(
  "Control", "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "C5",
  "C6", "C7", "C8", "C9", "C10"
)

df_Exp_type_Dose_Condition_G <- df_data_obs_IMD |> 
  filter(Experiment_type == "Growth") |> 
  dplyr::select(ID_experiment, Experiment_type, Dose, Condition) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  mutate(
    Condition = dplyr::recode(Condition, "Ctrl" = "Control"),
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = Condition_order)
  )

df_Exp_type_Dose_Condition_R <- df_data_obs_IMD |> 
  filter(Experiment_type == "Repro") |> 
  dplyr::select(ID_experiment, Experiment_type, Dose, Condition) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  mutate(
    Condition = dplyr::recode(Condition, "Ctrl" = "Control"),
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = Condition_order)
  )

ID_levels_growth <- df_Exp_type_Dose_Condition_G |> 
  filter(Experiment_type == "Growth") |> 
  arrange(Condition) |> 
  pull(ID_experiment)

Facet_levels_growth <- df_Exp_type_Dose_Condition_G |> 
  filter(Experiment_type == "Growth") |> 
  arrange(Condition) |> 
  mutate(Facet_label = paste(Condition, ":", Dose/1000, "mg/kg")) |> 
  pull(Facet_label)

ID_levels_repro <- df_Exp_type_Dose_Condition_R |> 
  filter(Experiment_type == "Repro") |> 
  arrange(Condition) |> 
  pull(ID_experiment)

Facet_levels_repro <- df_Exp_type_Dose_Condition_R |> 
  filter(Experiment_type == "Repro") |> 
  arrange(Condition) |> 
  mutate(Facet_label = paste(Condition, ":", Dose/1000, "mg/kg")) |> 
  pull(Facet_label)


df_pred_full_F_IMD_AG_plot_G <- df_pred_full_F_IMD_AG |> 
  left_join(
    df_Exp_type_Dose_Condition_G,
    by = c("ID_experiment")
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    ID_experiment = factor(ID_experiment, levels = ID_levels_growth),
    Facet_label = paste(Condition, ":", Dose/1000, "mg/kg"),
    Facet_label = factor(Facet_label, levels = Facet_levels_growth)
  )

df_data_obs_IMD_G <- df_data_obs_IMD |> 
  mutate(
    Condition = dplyr::recode(Condition, "Ctrl" = "Control"),
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = Condition_order),
    ID_experiment = factor(ID_experiment, levels = ID_levels_growth),
    Facet_label = paste(Condition, ":", Dose/1000, "mg/kg"),
    Facet_label = factor(Facet_label, levels = Facet_levels_growth)
  )


df_pred_full_F_IMD_AG_plot_R <- df_pred_full_F_IMD_AG |> 
  left_join(
    df_Exp_type_Dose_Condition_R,
    by = c("ID_experiment")
  ) |> 
  filter(Experiment_type == "Repro") |> 
  mutate(
    ID_experiment = factor(ID_experiment, levels = ID_levels_repro),
    Facet_label = paste(Condition, ":", Dose/1000, "mg/kg"),
    Facet_label = factor(Facet_label, levels = Facet_levels_repro)
  )

df_data_obs_IMD_R <- df_data_obs_IMD |> 
  mutate(
    Condition = dplyr::recode(Condition, "Ctrl" = "Control"),
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = Condition_order),
    ID_experiment = factor(ID_experiment, levels = ID_levels_repro),
    Facet_label = paste(Condition, ":", Dose/1000, "mg/kg"),
    Facet_label = factor(Facet_label, levels = Facet_levels_repro)
  )
```
